title: John Mack's death in a car crash; Sheehan looked into it
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of John Mack's death in a car crash; Sheehan looked into it, about 2004 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, I was on that within hours after it happened, you know, dug it out and knew who the guy was. The guy still in prison that that ran him down. He was just drunk and uh

plain: John Mack, a psychiatrist known for working with people who said they had met aliens, died after being hit by a car in 2004. A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says he looked into it within hours, found out who the driver was, and says the man was simply drunk and is still in prison. He tells it to answer the question of whether Mack's death was more than an accident.
